description_en: Call CreateSlrRole to create a service-linked role for Data Security Center (DSC). This role authorizes DSC to access your cloud resources
description_zh: 调用CreateSlrRole创建数据安全中心DSC（Data Security Center）的服务关联角色，授权DSC访问云资源
kebab_example: aliyun sddp create-slr-role --source-ip 106.11.XX.XX --feature-type 2 --lang zh_cn --service-name example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSlrRole
